$comment: SOAS MCP server. Two server entries are provided so you can pick the transport that matches your editor. The HTTP server (`soas`) is brought up by start.ps1 as a Docker container and is the recommended default. The legacy stdio bridge (`soas-stdio-bridge`) is kept for the VS Code extension that talks to its own port 19542 host bridge.

soas.$comment: Streamable-HTTP transport. The MCP server reads its SOAS bearer from the shared mcp_secrets volume; clients of THIS endpoint do not need to send any auth unless MCP_SERVER_TOKEN is set in .env.

soas-direct-stdio.$comment: Direct stdio fallback. Talks straight to the SOAS backend at localhost:8000 using the auto-generated service token mirrored at secrets/mcp_token. Use when you don't want to run the MCP container.

soas-stdio-bridge.$comment: Legacy stdio bridge that talks to the VS Code extension's local HTTP bridge. Only useful when the SOAS VS Code extension is running and you want webview integration (current-graph, current-wiki state).
